doc: How an item drops as random loot: its stack size and its rarities. One entry per item that can drop.

ids.rule: A loot entry has the id of its item (items registry). An entry whose item has no name is game:item_<its 32-bit item id as 8 hex digits>.

stack.doc: The stack size of a drop.

scalable.doc: The stack grows with the world's loot amount, up to maxScaled.

rarities.doc: The rarities a drop may roll.

fixedRarity.doc: A rarity every drop gets (none: rolled from rarities).

entry.removeDoc: GameStart only. Excludes the entry from random-loot candidates, retaining its record and item. Recipes, direct drops and already-owned copies are unchanged.
